verdicts.rationale: Batcher(window_ms=250) in libs/payments/batch.py adds up to 250ms per authorization (@@ -12,10 +12,40), which is real but roughly a sixth of the 1.6s regression, and the alert reports no change in error rate. Plausible contributor, not a demonstrated cause.
The shared httpx client in services/checkout/http.py keeps the default connection limits while serving all requests, which can queue under load; nothing in the diff pins it to the observed p99 shape.

Doubling workers 8 to 16 in deploy/checkout.yaml raises concurrency against the same downstream pools, which can increase queueing latency, but the manifest change was not part of a deploy in the window.

no_culprit_reason: Three changes touch the payment path and none explains a 1.6s p99 regression on its own; the top candidate reaches 0.35 confidence, below the 0.4 floor for naming a culprit.
